description: Several piles of playing cards are spread across the table, with a small deck near the bottom, a face-up ten of hearts in the center, and a cluster of face-up cards near the top. The right hand reaches up to the top cluster, pinches a card, and pulls it to the right toward the discard pile, while the left hand moves in to grasp the eight of spades from the small bottom deck, lifts it, and carries it upward toward the central pile, briefly holding it above the deck before repositioning it.
